title: REGER: Modeling inter-item Relations with Semantic IDs for Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.37584v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Personalized recommendation depends on learning semantic and collaborative relations among items from online content and user interactions. Generative recommendation (GR) offers a promising paradigm by autoregressively generating discrete semantic IDs (SIDs) of items. However, randomly initialized SID token embeddings and GR models trained from scratch do not directly inherit the semantic relations inherent in items, while inter-item collaborative relations are learned largely implicitly through token-level attention and next-token supervision. To address this limitation, we propose REGER, a unified framework that explicitly incorporates inter-item relations into semantic pretraining, history encoding, and SID generation. We pretrain the GR model through generative semantic retrieval, enabling it to inherit inter-item semantic similarity by learning to generate semantic neighbors' SIDs. We combine global attention with local attention

translated_title: REGER：基于语义ID建模物品间关系的生成式推荐
translated_abstract: 个性化推荐依赖于从在线内容和用户交互中学习物品之间的语义关系和协同关系。生成式推荐（GR）通过自回归地生成物品的离散语义ID（SIDs），提供了一种有前景的范式。然而，随机初始化的SID词元嵌入以及从零开始训练的GR模型并不能直接继承物品固有的语义关系，而物品间的协同关系主要是通过词元级注意力机制和下一词元预测监督被隐式学习的。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了REGER，这是一个统一框架，将物品间关系显式地融入语义预训练、历史编码和SID生成之中。我们通过生成式语义检索对GR模型进行预训练，使其通过学习生成语义邻居的SID来继承物品间的语义相似性。我们将全局注意力与局部注意力相结合……（摘要原文在此处不完整）
tldr: 提出REGER统一框架，通过生成式语义检索预训练使GR模型继承物品间语义相似性，并将物品间关系显式融入语义预训练、历史编码和SID生成的全过程。
en_tdlr: REGER is a unified framework that explicitly incorporates inter-item relations into semantic pretraining, history encoding, and SID generation, enabling the generative recommendation model to inherit inter-item semantic similarity through generative semantic retrieval pretraining.
